<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1e9d4dff95821d9627a28fc50fe89e67f946d303 -->

## What's Changed
### Blocks
* Finish sign block (#757) by @AshuraVie in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/786
* feat: Add Vanilla-compatible destructive explosions and TNT by @kdcokenny in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/428
* Feat: spawner by @chocodev11 in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/712
* feat: implement the enchanting table by @JosepBove in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/623
### Entities
* feat(entity): implementation of squid by @quaid-perkins in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/693
* Lingering Potions by @tangjuyo in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/817
* Conduit block entity by @nobuildersnotools in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/825
### Performance
* Perf/byte array identifier encoding by @Joniii11 in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/796
* Faster section encoding by @Vik-Varma in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/777
* perf: optimize VarInt and VarLong encoding by @Joniii11 in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/783
* perf: avoid per-entity tick allocations by @AshuraVie in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/797
* perf: batch join tab-list sync into a single CPlayerInfoUpdate by @carabistouflette in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/550
* make build time shorter for cicd profile by @JunkyDeveloper in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/814
* remove some LevelReader by @coco875 in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/365
* Domain Optimizations by @Vik-Varma in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/763
* perf: ~29% faster chunk generation by @Joniii11 in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/823
* perf: optimize entity spatial queries and pushing by @Joniii11 in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/815
### Features
* fix: emit fishing rod interaction vibrations by @AshuraVie in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/793
* fix: spawn baby offspring from eggs for non-ageable mobs by @AshuraVie in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/800
* fix: pick up nearby entities at the simulated player position by @AshuraVie in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/801
* Fix/item step sounds by @AshuraVie in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/802
* fix: play equip sounds by @AshuraVie in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/790
* fix: use vanilla's Mth functions by @AnthonyDuong1 in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/805
* Flint integration by @JunkyDeveloper in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/788
* small flint comment improvment by @JunkyDeveloper in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/808
* Build the worldgen crates for wasm32-unknown-unknown by @earomc in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/807
* now all ids needs to be implemented in steel by @JunkyDeveloper in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/810
* fix(entity): align LivingEntity hurt and death handling with vanilla by @Purdze in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/625
* feat: emit water entry splash events by @AshuraVie in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/792
* fix cargo run by @JunkyDeveloper in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/811
* remove test by @JunkyDeveloper in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/813
* Some vanilla mining speed modifiers by @nobuildersnotools in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/820
* Bed & Respawn Anchor explosions by @nobuildersnotools in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/821
* fix translated message by @Joniii11 in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/822
* feat: Advancement saving and loading by @aure31 in https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/pull/8
